fact: International Affairs (INTAF) led by Amy Flatten (Director), reporting to Francis Slakey (Chief External Affairs Officer, SLT member)
Team of 5: Amy Flatten (Director), Michele Irwin (Senior International Programs Manager), Shanaz Sulejmanovic (International Programs Manager), Lais Ribeiro (International Programs Associate)

Mission: help APS convene and connect the global physics community, establish APS as a Welcoming Global Hub, expand partnerships with national physics societies and international physics organizations
Managed 17 satellite sites with 11 contributed sessions and 6 watch parties for 2025 Global Physics Summit

Sloan Foundation grant supporting scientists affected by Russian invasion of Ukraine: 15 physicists collaborated with US/Europe partners, 5 grad students/postdocs attended international conferences, 3 physicists relocated to Italy
African Physics Newsletter: 1,226 subscribers across 40 African countries + diaspora, 46.2% open rate — highest of all APS newsletters (Nov 2024)
Active concern: US administration policies affecting international scientific collaboration, student mobility/visa issues, restrictions on visits/collaboration with certain scientists
